situation: Whether KV caches and multimodal embeddings can be shared across models.
decision: KV caches and hidden multimodal embeddings generally CANNOT be shared across different models, quantizations, or model revisions — replicate artifacts, don't reuse them.
reasoning_physics: A KV cache is keyed to a specific checkpoint's weights, quantization, engine, template, and adapters; any change invalidates the positional/attention values it encodes. Cross-model KV reuse produces garbage attention. Provenance-hash + replicate is the safe rule.
